spring.registry.k8s.description: One named block per Kubernetes Service-discovery backend. Each block becomes ONE backend bean named 'k8s.<name>' implementing discovery.Discovery (read) only — this backend contributes no registrar, because in a cluster the platform already registers every Pod behind a Service. The family-wide registration keys (spring.registry.service-name / .addr) belong to the registry core and are not consumed here. No default/unnamed block.

mode.description: 'dns' (headless Service SRV/A, no RBAC) or 'endpointslice' (client-go informer, real-time)

port-name.description: Named port to select; dns mode with a value issues an SRV query, endpointslice matches the slice port by name

port.description: Numeric port used when port-name is empty; required for dns A-record mode

cluster-domain.description: Cluster DNS suffix for the Service FQDN; dns mode only

refresh-interval.description: Duration string, e.g. '5s', '1m', '1h'; dns-mode re-resolve period

kubeconfig.description: Kubeconfig path for endpointslice mode; empty uses in-cluster ServiceAccount auth

resync-period.description: Duration string, e.g. '5s', '1m', '1h'; endpointslice informer resync period, 0 is event-driven only
